edit.why: The PMOS mirror output transistor's drain goes to node 3, not VDD.
The diode-connected PMOS has its drain tied to its gate (node 2), not VDD.
The input transistor's source goes to the tail node (node 4), the same net as the other input transistor's source.
The body pin was wrongly attached to a separate net.
This is a ground symbol, not a voltage source.
